from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="https://rent.broomy.laserraptor.eu/api/v1",
    api_key="YOUR_API_KEY",
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="qwen3.8-flash",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}],
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)

The model

Qwen 3.8 Flash

A Qwen 3.8 flash model served from European infrastructure. 256k context window, vision support, text output. Slower than Claude Code — but unlimited tokens and a fraction of the price.

  • • Context: 262,144 tokens
  • • Input modalities: text + image
  • • Output: text
  • • EU-hosted (no US/China routing)

Pricing questions

How does billing work?

Monthly subscription. Pay once per month, get unlimited access for that period. No auto-renewal surprises — cancel anytime.

Should I choose Basic or Pro?

Basic (€20/mo) is for light, occasional use with 1 concurrent request. Pro (€50/mo) is for daily workloads with 3 concurrent requests and priority queue.

What does 'unlimited tokens' mean?

No token cap. You can send as many tokens as you want — the only limit is how fast the model can generate (throughput), not a quota.

Do prices include VAT?

No. All prices are net, plus statutory VAT. Intended for businesses.

Can I use the OpenAI SDK?

Yes. The API is OpenAI-compatible. Point any OpenAI SDK at our base URL with your API key.

Top up and start building.

No subscription minimum. Your credits work with the model on this page.
